Fast-path cold-start routing; creates .routing-pending marker for non-trivial prompts without state.json
Denies impl writes without contract (cold-start and active-harness paths); type-aware bypass for spike/chore
Sandboxes evaluator writes to .harness/ only; staleness check (30min) for crash recovery
Blocks duplicate dev servers by checking common ports via lsof
Two-phase commit gate via .commit-approved flag; auto-breadcrumb; post-commit guidance
Blocks turn end if contract unverified or building without contract; type-aware bypass
Tier 1: requires breadcrumbs for 2+ file changes; Tier 2: harness nag for 4+ files without contract
Session fatigue detection (5 signals: duration, volume, consecutive fails, scraps, stuck feature)
Phase routing after subagent completion (PLAN GATE, CONTRACT NEGOTIATED, BUILD COMPLETE, EVAL INCOMPLETE)
Integration test suite for all hooks — not a Cursor hook itself

Python block walking input/toolInput/tool_input nested dicts for path/file_path/filePath
Sort tasks by priority, find building/pending, check if type is in gatable set {feature,bug,gap,fix}
Cross-platform file modification time: stat -f %m (macOS) || stat -c %Y (Linux)

dead_code.description: EVALS_DIR variable declared but never referenced anywhere in the script
dead_code.evidence: EVALS_DIR=".harness/evals" — grep of verify-harness.sh shows no other reference to EVALS_DIR

dead_code.description: BREADCRUMBS redeclared — already defined on line 17, redeclared on line 120 with identical value

behavioral_inconsistencies.description: contract-gate walks 3 nested key variants (input, toolInput, tool_input) with 3 path key variants each. evaluator-guard only checks data.get('input', data) with 2 path keys (path, file_path — missing filePath). evaluator-guard would miss paths sent as {toolInput: {filePath: '...'}}
behavioral_inconsistencies.recommendation: Unify path extraction — evaluator-guard should use the same defensive walk as contract-gate

behavioral_inconsistencies.description: contract-gate allows writes to .harness/ AND .cursor/hooks/. evaluator-guard only allows .harness/. An evaluator subagent writing to .cursor/hooks/ (e.g., clearing a flag file) would be denied by evaluator-guard but allowed by contract-gate
behavioral_inconsistencies.recommendation: Intentional — evaluator should not write to .cursor/hooks/. Document the difference.

behavioral_inconsistencies.description: preToolUse hooks (contract-gate, evaluator-guard) output '{}' for allow. beforeShellExecution hooks (dedup-server, pre-commit) output '{"permission":"allow"}'. Stop hooks output '{}'. Different events require different output schemas — this is correct behavior, not a bug.
behavioral_inconsistencies.recommendation: No fix needed — output format is dictated by hook event type

behavioral_inconsistencies.description: harness-context injects a cold-start routing note even with empty input. harness-gate only injects routing for prompts >100 chars that don't match simple patterns. A short non-trivial prompt (e.g., 'build auth' at 10 chars) gets the context note but no routing injection.
behavioral_inconsistencies.recommendation: Acceptable asymmetry — context note is informational, gate routing is actionable

behavioral_inconsistencies.description: harness-context reports 'could not be parsed' in additional_context (graceful). verify-harness falls through to python3 exception handler, prints 'False' for verified, and fires HARNESS GATE on malformed contract (false positive). contract-gate's python3 exception handler prints empty string for path, falls through to 'allow' (safe but loses gate enforcement).
behavioral_inconsistencies.recommendation: verify-harness should check if contract JSON is valid before reading verified field; contract-gate should deny when state.json is malformed (not silently allow)

edge_case_robustness.output: Reports parse failure gracefully in additional_context
{} (harness active — state.json exists even if malformed)
Fires HARNESS GATE (false positive — malformed contract treated as unverified)
Fires HARNESS GATE (empty contract has verified=False — correct behavior)

source_runtime_test.test_description: Verify that bash source command works for a shared hooks-lib.sh in the same directory as hook scripts, using $(dirname "$0") for path resolution
source_runtime_test.method: Created /tmp/hooks-source-test/hooks-lib.sh with two functions (hooks_log, hooks_test_value). Created test-source-hook.sh that sources it via SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd $(dirname $0) && pwd); source $SCRIPT_DIR/hooks-lib.sh. Ran: (1) direct invocation from hooks dir, (2) invocation from different working directory (/tmp)
source_runtime_test.evidence: Test 1: '{"test":"pass","source":"works","value":"HOOKS_LIB_WORKS"}' EXIT_CODE=0. Test 2 (different cwd): same output, EXIT_CODE=0. Path resolution via $(dirname $0) works regardless of caller's working directory.
source_runtime_test.conclusion: source works reliably in bash hook scripts. $(dirname "$0") correctly resolves to the hooks directory even when invoked from a different working directory (as Cursor does). hooks-lib.sh extraction is technically viable.

recommendations.title: Extract hooks-lib.sh with shared functions
recommendations.description: Create library/cursor/hooks/hooks-lib.sh with: hooks_init() (stdin + logging), hooks_extract_path() (unified path walk), hooks_read_state() (task sorting + gatable check), hooks_file_age() (cross-platform stat), hooks_skip_detected() (structured breadcrumb check). Update 6+ hooks to source it. Reduces total LOC by ~200 and eliminates the path extraction divergence between contract-gate and evaluator-guard.

recommendations.title: Fix harness-context.sh NameError (BUG-1)
recommendations.description: Guard the 'elif building:' branch with 'if os.path.isfile(state_path):' check. The 'building' variable is only defined inside the state_path block.

recommendations.title: Unify evaluator-guard path extraction (BUG-6)
recommendations.description: Replace evaluator-guard's simple path extraction with the same 3-key nested walk used by contract-gate. This closes a bypass where toolInput.filePath paths are silently allowed.

recommendations.title: Add validate-hooks.sh tests for untested hooks
recommendations.description: Add functional tests for contract-gate (deny without contract, allow with contract, type-aware bypass), evaluator-guard (deny impl write when flag active, allow harness write), and dedup-server (allow non-server command, mock port detection).

recommendations.title: Fix hooks-profile.sh stale messages (BUG-5)
recommendations.description: Update the lean/full echo messages in scripts/hooks-profile.sh to match actual hooks.lean.json and hooks.full.json content.

recommendations.title: Handle malformed contract in verify-harness (BUG-7)
recommendations.description: Add JSON validity check before reading verified field. If contract is malformed, report parse error instead of treating as unverified.

recommendations.title: Clean up dead code in verify-harness (BUG-3, BUG-4)
recommendations.description: Remove unused EVALS_DIR declaration and redundant BREADCRUMBS redeclaration.

go_no_go.rationale: All four GO thresholds are met: (1) source runtime test passes — $(dirname $0) resolves correctly from any working directory. (2) 5 patterns duplicated across 3+ hooks each (logging in 10/10, path extraction in 3 files, task sorting in 3 files, stat fallback in 3-4 files, skip detection in 2 files). (3) At least 2 bugs are directly fixable by extraction — BUG-2 (duplicate path extraction in contract-gate) and BUG-6 (inconsistent path extraction in evaluator-guard) both disappear when hooks_extract_path() is centralized. (4) Estimated effort is M (medium) — 6 hooks to update, ~200 LOC to extract, single session with careful testing.
conditions: hooks-lib.sh must use $(dirname $0) for path resolution — not hardcoded paths
Each migrated hook must produce identical output for known fixture inputs (byte-for-byte regression test)
Claude hooks should be documented as separate scope — not blocked by this extraction
